summary: The registered boohtacord-win-station now executes the GitVerse Windows job. Sparse checkout, pinned Flutter 3.47.5, locked dependency resolution, 224 tests and analysis passed. Windows release build is blocked by the missing Visual Studio C++ toolchain on the host.

checks.name: GitVerse Windows runner routing and checkout
checks.observation: The job was assigned after 2 seconds. Sparse checkout completed in 5 seconds with Git long paths enabled; the previous checkout attempt took 14 seconds and failed.

checks.name: Flutter dependencies, tests and analyzer
checks.observation: The runner verified Flutter 3.47.5, resolved the existing lockfile with dart pub get --enforce-lockfile, completed the Flutter test step in 25 seconds and analysis in 11 seconds. Local verification reported 224 passing tests; analysis has two non-fatal info diagnostics in the vendored flutter_webrtc package.

checks.name: Windows release build
checks.observation: The CI build step exits in 2 seconds: Unable to find suitable Visual Studio toolchain. Local flutter doctor -v also reports that Visual Studio is not installed. Installing the Desktop development with C++ workload requires host administration.

remaining: Install Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools with Desktop development with C++ on boohtacord-win-station, then rerun the Windows workflow and record a successful release build. Developer Mode should also be enabled so Flutter can create plugin symlinks in fresh local checkouts.
